result.reason: The redline removes all liquidated damages and penalties payable by Customer, achieving the preferred position. Replacing the punitive 15%-per-week charge with legally capped late-payment interest preserves the legitimate payment-enforcement purpose without retaining a liquidated amount. Limiting interest to undisputed amounts and excluding good-faith withholding under Section 7.3 is appropriately tailored and professionally drafted, though the clause could specify whether interest is simple rather than compounded.
